message0: clear tree area at x %1 y %2 z %3 radius %4 height %5
tooltip: Server-side only. Sets every block in the same (radius*2+1) square by (height+1) tall region used by 'capture tree structure' (centered on x,z, starting at y) back to air — use it right after capturing to clean up the grown tree before growing the next one. Use the same x/y/z/radius/height values you captured with.
